subject: Availability rotor pilot & next steps: schedule EU/APAC rotating deep-dive
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@finco.io>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@finco.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Availability rotor pilot & next steps: schedule EU/APAC rotating deep-dive

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for an excellent discovery conversation today. Quick recap of the key qualification points we captured:
- Primary use case: near-real-time inference for customer support routing and embeddings-based search.
- Spike volume: 5M tokens/month today, expected to double with Q4 push.
- Data sensitivity: PII redaction required; SOC2 and on-prem option important.
- Decision timeframe: procurement + security sign-off in ~6–8 weeks.

Next steps we proposed on the call: 1) schedule a 90-minute technical deep-dive with Solutions Engineering (SE) to walk architecture and live perf expectations; 2) share a mutual action plan and sample prompts; 3) pilot cadence that minimizes timezone friction.

To make scheduling easier for your distributed team, we suggest a two-week "rotor" pilot for demo/deep-dive slots: three rotating weekly windows that move forward one slot each week so the burden is shared across US / EU / APAC. Proposed windows (UTC):
- Slot A: Tue 15:00–16:30 UTC (US-friendly afternoon / EU morning)
- Slot B: Thu 08:00–09:30 UTC (APAC-friendly morning / EU late afternoon)
- Slot C: Fri 20:00–21:30 UTC (US evening / APAC morning)

Implementation: week 1 = SE Ben covers Slot A, Karthik covers Slot B, Vanessa covers Slot C; week 2 rotate assignments so each timebox hits a different region's workday. Attached is a one-page mutual_action_plan.xlsx and our discovery-notes.pdf for context.

Could you confirm which of these slots work for your team and any hard constraints (e.g., no Fridays, APAC folks only mornings)? If helpful, share preferred attendees for the deep-dive (arch/infra, security, product). Once we lock windows I’ll send calendar invites with dial-in + recording enabled.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0176

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes.pdf (PDF)

From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@finco.io>

Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@finco.io>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 02:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Availability rotor pilot & next steps: schedule EU/APAC rotating deep-dive

Vanessa —

Thanks for the detailed recap and the rotor concept — this looks promising. Quick notes from our side after syncing with the team:
- We like the rotating approach to share inconvenience across regions.
- Hard constraint: our APAC engineering team prefers only morning local times (they cannot do evenings).
- Primary attendees for the deep-dive: myself, Tom Reed (VP Product), and two platform engineers (names to follow).

Of the proposed UTC windows, we can do:
- Slot A (Tue 15:00–16:30 UTC): OK for EU and late-afternoon US folks
- Slot B (Thu 08:00–09:30 UTC): OK — this is APAC-friendly for our team in India/Singapore
- Slot C (Fri 20:00–21:30 UTC): this one is tough for APAC (our folks are asleep) and Tom would rather avoid Fridays

Suggested variant: keep A and B as-is, and instead of Slot C propose Mon 06:00–07:30 UTC (APAC morning / US very early) so APAC gets a true morning slot and we avoid Friday evenings.

Also: can you share the recording from today's call and the mutual_action_plan XLSX? If you can propose two concrete dates for the first deep-dive rotation (one in the next 7–10 days), that would help us confirm attendees.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Head of Data Platform | FinCo Analytics
alyssa.gomez@finco.io
